data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic and Urdu word ‘irsa’, meaning ‘a little one’ or ‘garden’. It is a beautiful name for a baby girl, evoking images of tenderness, nurturing, and growth. The name Irsa carries the meaning “Little one, or Garden” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Irsa usually hope their child will grow to embody little one, or garden and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Irsa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little one, or Garden.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Irsa total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

The beauty and significance of gardens are deeply rooted in various Middle Eastern cultures, symbolizing paradise and tranquility.
